nodes.label: Case Notes List View - Nexo Commercial Distributors Corp. (Case #6)
nodes.description: UI screenshot of the 'Case notes' list/detail page in the Captio application. Shows case #6 for 'Nexo Commercial Distributors Corp.' categorized as Business / Contract. A note card titled 'Case review' is displayed with truncated text: 'We review the case with the client on tuesday. He gave us the files he mentioned on the fo...' and tagged as 'Independent'. Navigation includes breadcrumb back to Cases, an Options button, and a user avatar labeled 'tole' in the top-right corner. Light blue/gray UI theme with a clean card-based layout. This is the notes listing view (post-creation), contrasting with the note-creation form shown in the 14-51-17 screenshot.
